title: FPGA 資料流加速器
summary: 以HLS、串流管線與有限資源映射連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect hls, streaming pipelines and finite resource mapping through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: C 模型與硬體契約
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「C 模型與硬體契約」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop c models and hardware contracts through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 功能契約：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「功能契約」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for functional contract.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「功能契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for functional contract. Correct C output does not establish hardware timing. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Define input, output and completion. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：II 與每筆資料延遲必定相等。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: II always equals per-item latency. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「功能契約」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit functional contract two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 功能契約的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。
knowledge.textEn: Correct C output does not establish hardware timing.

knowledge.title: 功能契約的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Define input, output and completion. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設時脈 200 MHz、起始間隔 II=2 cycles，穩態每週期組輸出一筆 4 B，吞吐=100 M筆/s=400 MB/s。延遲 20 cycles=100 ns；短批次另計填充及排空。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 200 MHz, initiation interval II=2 cycles and one 4 B result per initiation. Steady throughput=100 Mitems/s=400 MB/s; 20-cycle latency=100 ns. Short batches also pay fill and drain.

quiz.question: 本步審查「功能契約」與整體「FPGA 資料流加速器」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing functional contract within fpga dataflow accelerators, which statement or check is supported?
options: C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。
II 與每筆資料延遲必定相等。
迴圈展開後記憶體埠數不再重要。
optionsEn: Correct C output does not establish hardware timing.
II always equals per-item latency.
Memory ports cease to matter after loop unrolling.
quiz.explanation: C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。 建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Correct C output does not establish hardware timing. Define input, output and completion. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 功能契約：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。」檢查「功能契約」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for functional contract using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「功能契約」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。 核對「C 結果正確不代表硬體時序合格。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for functional contract and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Define input, output and completion. Check the principle: Correct C output does not establish hardware timing. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：II 與每筆資料延遲必定相等。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: II always equals per-item latency. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「功能契約」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立輸入、輸出及完成定義。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit functional contract input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.objective: 以「介面握手」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for interface handshake.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「介面握手」的資料、控制與時間關係。有效與就緒共同決定資料轉移。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for interface handshake. Valid and ready jointly determine transfers. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Enumerate stalls and continuous transfers. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：迴圈展開後記憶體埠數不再重要。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Memory ports cease to matter after loop unrolling. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「介面握手」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「有效與就緒共同決定資料轉移。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit interface handshake two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.text: 有效與就緒共同決定資料轉移。
knowledge.textEn: Valid and ready jointly determine transfers.

knowledge.title: 介面握手的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Enumerate stalls and continuous transfers. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「介面握手」與整體「FPGA 資料流加速器」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing interface handshake within fpga dataflow accelerators, which statement or check is supported?
options: 有效與就緒共同決定資料轉移。
II 與每筆資料延遲必定相等。
迴圈展開後記憶體埠數不再重要。
optionsEn: Valid and ready jointly determine transfers.
II always equals per-item latency.
Memory ports cease to matter after loop unrolling.
quiz.explanation: 有效與就緒共同決定資料轉移。 枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Valid and ready jointly determine transfers. Enumerate stalls and continuous transfers. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 介面握手：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。」檢查「介面握手」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for interface handshake using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「介面握手」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。 核對「有效與就緒共同決定資料轉移。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for interface handshake and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Enumerate stalls and continuous transfers. Check the principle: Valid and ready jointly determine transfers. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：迴圈展開後記憶體埠數不再重要。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Memory ports cease to matter after loop unrolling. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「介面握手」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「枚舉暫停與連續傳輸時序。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit interface handshake input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
